thread:
incident-bot: [PAGE] HIGH latency spike - streaming stalls observed for user-facing inference. p95 jumped to 1.2s (baseline 200ms), p99 ~3.9s, ~12% of active streams reporting stalls. Affected model: open-v2-int8-calib:2026-03-14. Pager: @alex oncall.

alex: ack, I'm on it. grabbing the dashboard now.

alex: quick summary of symptoms? is it new deploy?

mira: we shipped a calibration tweak to int8 profiles 45m ago to reduce token cost on long-context jobs. rollout was staged global.

mira: early signal looked fine on perf CI, but we saw KV cache regen in emulators for >512 context. possible extra memcpy causing stalls.

jules: seeing CPU convoy on the IO threads of the grpc proxy too. network queues backpressuring the runtime.

sam: adding some numbers from logs:
```
streaming_stalls.count: 1280 (last 15m)
p95.latency.tokens: 1.2s
p99.latency.tokens: 3.9s
kv-cache-insert-latency.p99: 120ms (normal 12ms)
```

lee: in the traces I see repeated dequant->reorder ops for the int8 path, spikes line up with calibration-enabled nodes.

alex: hypothesis: int8 calibration runtime path introduced an expensive conversion on first access leading to tail latency spikes for streaming sessions that miss prefix cache.

jules: agree. mitigation options: 1) rollback calibration profile, 2) route streaming traffic to fp16 fallback variant, 3) temporarily enable KV-prefill to avoid first-access penalty.

mira: we can rollback profile quickly from the model config service. rollback command: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/models/open-v2-int8-calib/rollback -d '{"to": "open-v2-int8-calib@stable-2026-03-13"}'`

sam: tried a canary rollback on us-east-1 test pool - latency normalized in 3m.

ops-bot: NOTICE: Routing policy updated for model open-v2-int8-calib in us-east-1 -> 50% traffic diverted to open-v2-fp16-stable by @sam.

alex: good. initiate global rollback and divert remaining traffic to fp16 fallback. we should also raise throttling windows for long streaming sessions until KV-prefill is in place.

jules: executing rollback now. command run: `modelctl promote --model open-v2-int8-calib@stable-2026-03-13 --scope global --force`

mira: i'm watching the ML serving metrics. starting rollback. will monitor for quality regressions.

sam: post-rollback metrics (5m after):
```
p95: 220ms -> back to baseline
p99: 270ms -> down from 3.9s
streaming_stalls.count: dropped 92% in region
```

alex: nice. keep the fp16 diversion at 20% for the next 30m while we verify.

cs-lead: customer-impact note: one enterprise tenant (acme-payments) reported slow UI updates for chat embedding flows. CS notified them and offered status update. no SLA credit yet, but potential for p99 concerns.

lee: creating a follow-up job to run synthetic long-context requests against int8 calibration nodes to reproduce locally.

mira: root cause likely calibration-induced dequant reorder that wasn't exercised by perf CI (rare cache miss pattern). we'll add a regen test to CI and block future calibs until passing.

jules: ACTIONS:
- rollback completed & verified (jules)
- keep fp16 diversion 20% for 30m (sam)
- create perf regression test for KV/cache miss (mira)
- update runbook: add int8 calibration post-deploy streaming probe (alex)
- inform customers and track CS tickets (cs-lead)

alex: does anyone object to marking this as a live mitigation resolved and switching to postmortem state?

sam: no objections. I'll close the paging and mark incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-14T02:01Z -> mitigated by rollback & routing change. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.

mira: we'll prepare a short blameless postmortem draft and include quant profile test additions + rollout guardrails.

cs-lead: I'll collate impacted customer list and draft comms.

alex: handing off to night oncall @lee for overnight watch, final check-in at 00:30 UTC. if p99 creeps above 500ms reopen paging.

lee: ack handoff, I'll watch the topology and streaming stalls dashboard.

jules: leaving a couple helpful snippets for postmortem:
```
- prometheus query: sum(rate(streaming_stalls[5m])) by (region)
- trace example id: trace-0a1b2c3d
- model config diff: open-v2-int8-calib@2026-03-14 (calib params)
```

sam: thanks all. retrospective scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.

alex: logging final note: mitigation succeeded, customer impact limited to transient UI slowdowns, root cause under investigation by ML and eng. postmortem will own next steps. :white_check_mark:
